description: A wallet's Zero Dark orders as the chain has them: commitment, market, the session key that committed it, when, filled lots and status (live, cancelled, filled, done). An order's terms are not on chain until any part of it fills, or a stale removal is tried on it (whether it succeeds or fails); then the whole opening is in that transaction. Until then the agent that placed an order keeps them.

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...): the transactions are built for it to sign
